department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefit: SC/ST people and women can get a bank loan of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore to start a new business (manufacturing, services, trading or farm-related work). The loan covers machines and working capital. You get a RuPay debit card and help with training and project reports.

other: You must be a woman, or an SC/ST man.
It must be a new (greenfield) business.
You must not have failed to repay a bank loan.

documents: ID proof (voter ID, passport, driving licence or PAN)
Caste certificate if you are SC/ST
Rent agreement if the shop is rented
how_to_apply: Go to your nearest bank branch, or the Lead District Manager, or register on the Stand-Up Mitra portal. Fill your business details and register. The bank will then contact you.
where_to_apply: Nearest bank branch, Lead District Manager (LDM), or www.standupmitra.in

evidence.quote: A scheme by Ministry of Finance
financing SC/ST and/or Women Entrepreneurs
facilitate bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 Crore
greenfield project enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading sector and activities allied to agriculture
composite loan (inclusive of term loan and working capital)
Rupay debit card to be issued for convenience of the borrower.
project report preparation
The age of the applicant must be at least 18 years.
If the applicant is a male, he must be from SC / ST category.
Finance is provided for Greenfield Enterprises.
The applicant must not be in default to any bank/financial institution.
